limits.guard_coverage: The guard wraps the global fetch of the agent process only. node:https, node:http and child processes are NOT covered.
limits.key_scope: The key exists only in the environment of the agent process (spawn env) and is not passed to agent evidence. Engineering tools run under bwrap --clearenv (packages/agent-isolation-attestation/index.js:364) with an environment declared as not inherited (profiles.js:205). Read from the code, not measured in a run.
limits.protected_comparison: Protected cases compare with JSON.stringify: undefined, NaN, -0 and object key order are not distinguished.
limits.request_cap_effect: The cap of 8 requests per execution punishes the control by exhaustion: it confounds "memory helps to get it right" with "memory helps to finish within the limit". The analysis reports how many controls hit the limit (analysis.controls_at_request_limit).
